title: Pages cached on Vercel started returning x-vercel-cache MISS on every request after September 30, 2026
symptoms: x-vercel-cache: MISS on routes that used to HIT
Runtime logs show cache reason vary_key_denied:cookie
Origin load and function invocations rise with no code change
cause: Since September 30, 2026 the Vercel CDN refuses to store any response whose Vary header names Cookie. Middleware or frameworks that add Vary: Cookie globally make those routes uncacheable.
fix: Remove Cookie from Vary on routes that do not change per visitor, and set Vary only on the routes that need it.
